definition: Applied Artificial Intelligence is a peer-reviewed scientific journal covering applications of artificial intelligence in management, industry, engineering, administration, and education, as well as evaluations of existing AI systems and tools and their economic, social, and cultural impact.
details: Applied Artificial Intelligence is a peer-reviewed scientific journal covering applications of artificial intelligence in management, industry, engineering, administration, and education, as well as evaluations of existing AI systems and tools and their economic, social, and cultural impact.

explainer.lead: Applied Artificial Intelligence is a peer-reviewed scientific journal, not an AI technique or software tool. It covers AI systems in practical settings and evaluations of their performance and economic, social, and cultural effects.

tiers.eli5: Think of it as a checked collection of reports about smart computer systems being used in real life. Experts read the reports before publication, much like a teacher checking work before it is shared with a class. The reports can describe uses in schools, businesses, and engineering, as well as how the systems affect people.
tiers.practitioner: An engineer can use the journal to read about AI applications and evaluations of existing systems and tools, or as a venue for suitable applied work. Relevant settings include management, industry, engineering, administration, and education. Do not treat the journal title as the name of a deployable framework; evaluation within its scope can also address economic, social, and cultural impact.
tiers.paperLevel: Applied Artificial Intelligence is formally a peer-reviewed scientific journal covering AI applications in management, industry, engineering, administration, and education. Its scope also includes evaluations of existing AI systems and tools and their economic, social, and cultural impact, rather than defining a particular algorithm, model, or experimental protocol.

explainer.example: A team could evaluate an AI scheduling tool used in factory management, describing its practical use and examining its effects on costs and working practices. That combination of application, system evaluation, and wider impact fits the journal's stated scope.

explainer.outcome: The journal publishes peer-reviewed research on practical AI and evaluations of existing systems and tools. Its coverage extends beyond technical performance to economic, social, and cultural impact.
explainer.whyItMatters: It provides a dedicated venue for examining AI as it is applied and evaluated in real settings. Including wider impacts helps connect technical systems with their consequences for organisations and society.
